source.name: US EPA TRI Basic Data Files

coverage.description: One reviewed 2024 facility identity, zero imported release observations until original EPA 2024 Basic CSV is processed. This is not a zero-emissions result.

disclaimers: No mass is displayed as company-specific without an original EPA facility/chemical/year Form R record.
An empty file means not imported. Form A zeros do not represent measured zero releases.
EPA TRI quantity is a facility-reported estimate, not a person-level exposure or injury assessment.
